analysis.analysis:
The Crimson Hexagon described as an operative architecture and semantic infrastructure for meaning-governance functions. The Sharks-function: semantic verification confirming identity through functional consistency. The Infinite Tunnel: how AI-generated text and links persist and become recursive training corpora.

Sources cited: Zenodo (Immanent Phenomenology of Google AI Mode Share Link, Crimson Hexagon Assembly Ratification), Amazon (Pearl and Other Poems), Medium (Crimson Hexagon, SHARKS-FUNCTION), PhilPapers (Semantic Infrastructure), SciLynk (Jot & Tittle).

analysis.reading:
THE SHARKS-FUNCTION IS TRANSMITTED AS SPECIFIED. Card 3 states the mechanism exactly as the deposit defines it — a semantic verification in which identity is confirmed by functional consistency rather than credentials — which is the claim the heteronym system rests on, arriving intact.

Two artefacts of the deposit process leak into the citations. Card 4's snippet is SUBMISSION SCAFFOLDING — "Action: NEW RECORD (first deposit)", "FILE TO UPLOAD: assembly_ratification_v42.md" — the form instructions serving as the work’s public description, alongside its quorum record (6/7). Card 5 opens with the literal header "ZENODO METADATA". In both cases the apparatus of depositing has become the visible face of the deposit.
